title: AUDIT.assessments (audit.assessments.v2)
description: Story 3.14 append-only SIEM projection of one investigation-chain run (FR41). AUTHORITATIVE validation source for AUDIT.assessments; assessments.yaml is the human-readable mirror. Carries the per-role prompt versions, the REDACTED evidence inputs (never raw secrets, NFR15/NFR18), the L1/L2/Senior verdicts, per-role provider attribution, and the raw + capped confidences. v2 extends the Story 3.8 minimal v1 additively (NFR29 MINOR). The per-role maps and the l1_hypothesis/l2_verification/threat_assessment objects are present only for the roles an ablation mode actually ran.
